title: Joomla Extension - phoca.cz - Stored XSS through author website in frontend upload in Phoca Download extension…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the Phoca Download Joomla extension versions 3.0.6 through 6.1.6. The vulnerability arises from an overly permissive URL validation on the author website field in the frontend upload form, which is rendered without proper escaping. This allows users with frontend upload permissions to inject malicious HTML attributes into file and category views.
